scope: Spring 2027 default for meal-plan administration while available; prominent continuation action; reconcile removed paid meal choices and permit guarded reselection.
sourceDocument: Spring 2027 Approve Your Bill Issues & Questions_-6.pdf
dependencies: Existing verified CF-033 environment baseline; no other newly prepared unit required.
notes: Explicit admin term overrides the default. The global/student current term is unchanged.

Confirmed admin assignment removal soft-deletes only the matching local paid choice. Previously removed choices are hidden only after a live absence check; GET preserves audit rows. POST rechecks assignments before replacing an old choice.
Pending or unconfirmed choices are preserved. Current assignments, existing bill approval, missing live source and unrelated term/student records cannot be bypassed.
Existing RemoveStudentMealPlan permission is retained. Removal does not promise tax reversal, a refund or general ledger adjustment.
promotionNotes: Deployed on isolated environment-specific release branches. For later promotion/removal, select this unit and verify the current target release; preserve unrelated units, settings and assets.
removalNotes: Revert only this unit from the current target release. Preserve later/unrelated units and any stored historical records. Data side effects are not reversed by code removal.
